ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient interview and triage simulator designed to train frontline community healthcare workers in rural Maharashtra.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation - solving a real-world regional healthcare training shortage through technology.
ideas.title: Clinical-Simulator for Local Health Workers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the judges' emphasis on real-world problem-solving and business potential by addressing a massive local service gap in medical training.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven branch-like digital onboarding platform that helps micro-entrepreneurs and street vendors structure documentation to apply for micro-loans.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation - financial inclusion and bridging the gap between unorganized sector businesses and institutional credit.
ideas.title: CapitalCue Regional SME Loan Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high business viability with a polished user-facing MVP, aligning perfectly with the Shark Tank finale focus on investor-style pitch potential.

ideas.pitch: A short-form video platform helping users learn regional Indian dialects through peer-generated micro-vignettes and real-time pronunciation scoring.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation - preserving linguistic diversity and easing migration integration for workers moving to urban economic hubs like Pune.
ideas.title: Mora-Local: Vernacular Dialect Exchange
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning pattern from language-learning apps while solving a hyper-local socio-economic integration challenge.

ideas.pitch: An Android app utilizing phone cameras and lightweight machine learning models to monitor ergonomic posture for industrial assembly-line workers.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation - workplace safety and occupational health monitoring for the manufacturing and SME sectors.
ideas.title: FitSense Posture Correction for Factory Workers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a hard engineering implementation using on-device computer vision that can be shown live during the offline Shark Tank pitch.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous data incident response agent that detects supply chain bottlenecks or cold-chain temperature anomalies and auto-generates supplier notification PRs.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation - tackling agricultural wastage and logistics inefficiencies through automated data remediation.
ideas.title: BlackBox Agri-Supply Chain Incident Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Highlights complex systems engineering and autonomous agents, which appeals strongly to a technical judging panel looking for serious technological depth.
